profile.summary: EGH International Berhad, through its subsidiaries, provides integrated interior fit-out solutions and sells furniture, fittings and equipment (FF&E) and building materials. The company operates through two segments: Provision of Interior Fit-Out Services and Sale of FF&E and Building Materials. The company provides end-to-end interior fit-out services, including design, construction, installation, and completion of interior spaces, structured as turnkey execution projects or design-and-build projects, which include project planning and management, coordination of subcontractors, procurement of FF&E and building materials, and overall supervision of works. The company provides interior fit-out services for hotels and resorts, corporate offices, healthcare facilities, educational institutions, retail outlets, restaurants, airport lounges, showrooms, and residential buildings. The company carries out wood works and designs custom-made wooden furniture, joinery components, and related products as an in-house carpentry manufacturer. It provides mechanical and electrical integration services, renovation, painting, and demolition works. The company trades furniture, building materials, and related products, and tenders for FF&E and building material supply projects. It engages in the wholesale and retail sale of fittings and fixtures. The company serves project owners, main contractors, subcontractors, interior designers, and retail customers, primarily in Malaysia. EGH International Berhad was founded in 2010 and is based in Puchong, Malaysia.
profile.zh: EGH International Berhad 成立于2010年，总部位于马来西亚蒲种，通过子公司提供综合室内装修解决方案，并销售家具、固定装置和设备（FF&E）及建筑材料。公司运营分为提供室内装修服务和销售FF&E及建筑材料两个分部。
lines: 室内装修服务：提供端到端的室内装修服务，包括设计、施工、安装和完工，以交钥匙或设计建造项目形式执行，涵盖项目管理、分包商协调、材料采购和监督，客户包括酒店、办公室、医疗设施、教育机构、零售店、餐厅、机场休息室、展厅和住宅建筑。
木工制造：作为内部木工制造商，进行木工工作并设计定制木制家具、细木工组件及相关产品。
机电与翻新：提供机电整合服务、翻新、油漆和拆除工程。
贸易与供应：交易家具、建筑材料及相关产品，并投标FF&E和建筑材料供应项目。
批发零售：从事配件和固定装置的批发和零售销售，服务对象包括项目业主、主承包商、分包商、室内设计师和零售客户。
lines_en: Interior Fit-Out Services: Provides end-to-end interior fit-out services including design, construction, installation, and completion, structured as turnkey or design-and-build projects, covering project planning, subcontractor coordination, procurement, and supervision for hotels, offices, healthcare facilities, educational institutions, retail outlets, restaurants, airport lounges, showrooms, and residential buildings.
Carpentry Manufacturing: Operates as an in-house carpentry manufacturer for wood works and designs custom-made wooden furniture, joinery components, and related products.
M&E and Renovation: Provides mechanical and electrical integration services, renovation, painting, and demolition works.
Trading and Supply: Trades furniture, building materials, and related products, and tenders for FF&E and building material supply projects.
Wholesale and Retail: Engages in wholesale and retail sale of fittings and fixtures, serving project owners, main contractors, subcontractors, interior designers, and retail customers.
